apps.title: Word Puzzle Journey
apps.summary:
Clear the board and travel the world, word by word. Word Puzzle Journey is a relaxing word puzzle game: swipe to connect letters, find the hidden words, and watch the board clear to reveal the breathtaking landmark behind it.

How to play
• Swipe across the letter tiles to spell words: up, down, left, or right, even around corners and backwards.
• The number on each tile shows how often you can still use that letter.
• Used-up tiles disappear. Find all the hidden words to clear the board and finish the level.

A relaxing word game with no timer
Take your time. There’s no timer, no move limit, and no lives, and every word puzzle stays solvable whatever you try. A wrong word costs nothing, so you can play at your own pace. It’s a cozy word game for adults of every age who like to unwind with a puzzle.

Travel the world, landmark by landmark
Word travel takes you from country to country and from one famous landmark to the next: the Statue of Liberty, the Eiffel Tower, the Colosseum, Tulum, Mount Fuji, Santorini, and many more. Sunny coastlines, snowy peaks, and ancient temples give every stop its own look. Finish a place and your next stop is waiting. A friendly suitcase travels with you and cheers you on.

Brain games that grow with you
Start with easy word puzzles, then take on Hard and Super hard levels with more words to find. Spot bonus words for extra coins and grow your vocabulary along the way. If you enjoy word scrambles, anagrams, and spelling games, you’ll find plenty to enjoy here: every board is a fresh letter puzzle that keeps your brain busy. Levels never run out, so your journey never has to end.

Helpers for tricky words
• Magnifier: reveals a letter.
• Firework: reveals 5 random letters.
• Earn coins as you play, and claim a coin bonus in the shop every few hours.

Word games in English or German
Play in English or German, each with its own word puzzles, and switch any time in Settings.

Word Puzzle Journey contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

Your trip around the world starts with the very first word.

apps.title: Spiral Smash
apps.summary:
Twist. Drop. SMASH!

Spiral Smash is a one-finger arcade game that's easy to pick up and hard to put down. Drag to spin the tower, line up the gaps and send your ball bouncing all the way to the bottom.

FALL FAST, HIT HARD
Drop through three rings in a row without landing and your ball powers up. The next ring it hits breaks apart, even a red one. Chain your drops, build your streak and smash through the spiral.

WATCH THE RED
Red spiked sections end your run. Line up the gaps, read the tower and don't panic when it speeds up.

GRAB A SHIELD
Look out for spinning shields hidden in the gaps. Grab one to bank an extra life that saves you from one bad landing.

ALWAYS A NEW CHALLENGE
Every level brings a new tower. Some rings split into several gaps, some spin by themselves, and the drops get faster and steeper as you climb. How far can you get?

CELEBRATE EVERY WIN
Reach the bottom for fireworks and confetti, then see how many streaks you pulled off and how many tries it took.

FEATURES
• Simple one-finger drag controls
• Satisfying ring-smashing combos
• Shield pickups for an extra life
• Levels that keep getting harder
• Bright 3D towers and punchy effects

Download Spiral Smash and start dropping!

Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

apps.summary:
Riley Ashford and her brother Jake are treasure hunters who are looking for an adventure deep within the Bermuda Triangle. Along with their pilot, Marcus Reed, they venture into the unknown — but a powerful magnetic storm suddenly strikes their helicopter.

Jake disappears during the crash. Riley and Marcus are separated, and Riley wakes up alone on a strange island with no way back.

Now she must survive.

Explore mysterious islands, break objects, gather valuable resources, and use everything you find to stay alive. Upgrade Riley’s tools to destroy tougher obstacles and unlock new resources, then craft and improve powerful weapons to face the dangerous enemies lurking across the islands.

But survival is only the beginning.

apps.title: Candy Cannon Sort
apps.summary:
Aim. Fling. Watch the tubes ERUPT!

Candy Cannon Sort mixes ball sort with a bubble shooter. Instead of moving balls from tube to tube, you fire glossy candy balls from a cannon straight into glass tubes. Fill a tube with 4 balls of one color and it erupts in a geyser of rainbow confetti and clears.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag back and let go (or just tap a tube) to fling the loaded candy.
• Watch the chute: you can see the next balls coming, so plan ahead.
• 4 of one color in a tube = SWEET! The tube erupts and empties.
• Every eruption shakes the wrong balls off the neighboring tubes. They fly home into a matching tube or back into your cannon.
• Clear every color to win. Run out of room and the level is over.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Chain reactions: one good shot can set off SWEET, GREAT, AMAZING and SUGAR RUSH combos in a row, each one louder and bigger than the last.
• Big payoffs: rainbow confetti, candy rain and a LEVEL CLEAR party on every win.
• Quick levels: most take under a minute, and the next one starts right away.
• Over 1000 levels across five candy worlds: Lollipop Lane, Gumdrop Grove, Caramel Canyon, Bubblegum Bay and Minty Peaks.
• New twists keep coming: purple "?" Mystery Candy that only shows its color when it reaches the top, rainbow Jawbreakers, Tricky levels and Sweet Shot bonus levels that pay triple coins.
• Handy boosters: Undo, Hammer and Shuffle help you out of a tight spot.
• Juicy toy look: bright rainbow candy, shiny glass tubes and playful sounds.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play. The game shows ads, and some rewards are unlocked by watching an optional ad.
• No in-app purchases.
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi needed for the puzzles.
• One finger is all you need.

Load the cannon, sort the candy and chase your sweetest chain in Candy Cannon Sort!

apps.title: Domino Blast: Block Puzzle
apps.summary:
Drop blocks. Clear a line. Watch the dominoes fall!

Domino Blast is a colourful block puzzle with a twist. Drag block pieces onto an 8x8 board to fill rows and columns. The dominoes standing on the board count as filled cells too.

Complete a line with a domino in it and the domino tips over. It rushes across the board along its arrow, smashes every block in its path and knocks over the next domino. Chains turn corners, and the fallen dominoes can complete even more lines. One smart move can set off a huge chain reaction.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a piece from the tray onto the board
• Fill a full row or column to clear it
• Topple the dominoes and let the chain do the rest
• Free every domino, or smash the target number of blocks, to clear the level
• No piece fits? You're out of room. Try again, or call in a Domino Drop

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One simple move, easy to learn in seconds
• Big chain reactions with bursts, shakes and rising combo sounds
• Bright, glossy candy colours that are easy to read
• Short levels that flow straight into the next one
• Rainbow dominoes that tip in every direction
• A reward chest every few levels
• Endless levels: ice blocks, bombs and stone walls join the board as you go
• Boss levels with giant chains, and a fresh world look every 40 levels
• Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed (ads and ad rewards need a connection)

Domino Blast is free to play. It contains ads, including optional reward ads.

Line up the pieces, tip the first domino and blast the board clean!

- See how many people stepped into your story and how far they went

Questions or feedback: nightstand@enjoy.ai

apps.title: Drunkn Bar Fight Mobile
apps.summary:
Welcome to the official mobile version of Drunkn Bar Fight VR!

The place is packed, the music is loud, and everybody is in the mood for a brawl. Grab whatever is nearby and get ready for crazy chaos that fits right in your pocket.

YOUR PERSONAL BRAWL SIMULATOR
Think of it as a bar simulator where nothing makes sense and everything is funny. You punch, kick, grab and throw, and the crowd reacts in the most dramatic way possible. Every fight is a tiny story with ragdoll physics, flying chairs and shocked faces.

GRAB IT, THROW IT
Almost anything you see can become a weapon. Bottles, stools, chairs and other bar stuff are all fair game. Pick something up, take aim and send it across the room. You can even throw people. Yes, really!

GAME FEATURES
✪ Funny ragdoll physics for silly hit reactions
✪ Bottles, chairs, stools and more to use as weapons
✪ Level progression, rewards and character customization
✪ Punch, grab, throw and kick your way through the night
✪ Many chaotic places to explore and smash
✪ Hilarious bar fights with wacky characters
✪ Simple touch controls made for mobile
✪ A physics sandbox with no boring moments
✪ Multiplayer fun for you and your friends

RAGDOLL PHYSICS AT WORK
Every hit sends someone flying in a floppy, wobbly way. Thanks to ragdoll physics, no two fights play out the same. A light shove can turn into a spinning flight. A big swing can leave a surprised guy lying on a table. That is ragdoll comedy in action.

A PLAYGROUND FOR TROUBLEMAKERS
Every location is a playground made for smashing, tossing and tumbling. Look around, pick a target and make a mess. Bars, parties, streets and supermarkets are all waiting for you.

Think of the game as a physics sandbox where you decide how the night goes. Want to kick a stool across the room? Go ahead. Want to toss a bottle at the wall? Sure. This sandbox rewards curiosity and a big sense of humor.

BRING YOUR FRIENDS
Chaos is better with a crew. Multiplayer fights turn into laughing fits when your buddy gets launched by a flying chair. Team up, plan a sneaky attack or just run around and cause trouble.

QUICK SESSIONS, BIG LAUGHS
Got ten minutes? Jump in, start a brawl, and see how much damage you can cause before last call. It is a perfect way to kick back after a long day and let off some steam.

Let's make some noise!
Step into a playground where the rules are optional. Invite your friends, pick up a bottle and kick off the party. Bring a buddy to every multiplayer match and share the laughs. It is a fun simulator with one big question: how much chaos can you cause?

Download Drunkn Bar Fight now, step into the chaos, and win your next fight today!

apps.title: Score Royale
apps.summary:
Score Royale turns a standard 52-card deck into a strategy board. Lay your cards out across five tracks, complete classic card combinations, and settle each track for points. Every card you place changes what the next one is worth.

Each round deals you a full deck and five open tracks. A track holds up to five cards and settles the moment it is full, so the order you play matters as much as the cards you keep. Take the safe pairing, or set a card aside in the swap area and reach for a stronger combination.

Five tracks, five spaces each — arrange all 52 cards and settle every track
Classic card combinations, from a simple pair up to the strongest five-card run
Stacked multipliers — the tougher the combination, the higher the score
Swap area to set a card aside and rebuild your layout
Time and heart rewards added to your final result
Four rooms with different deck counts, timers and target scores
Daily challenges and match history to follow your progress
A guided tutorial covering every combination and multiplier

The four rooms each play differently. Bronze gives you room to learn, Silver and Gold tighten the clock, and Diamond asks for the highest target score of all with the least time to reach it. Beat a room's target score and it stays unlocked. The round also ends when your hearts run out or the last card is played.

Start as a guest in seconds, or register with an email address to carry your progress between devices. If your hearts run out or the clock beats you, one optional rewarded ad lets you continue, once per round.

Score Royale is a single-player card strategy game. In-game coins are earned through gameplay only and cannot be purchased or exchanged.

apps.title: Arrow 3D: Space Puzzle
apps.summary:
Explore Arrow 3D: Space Puzzle, a tactile 3D cube puzzle that blends calm presentation with satisfying, brain-teasing challenges. Each level is a compact mechanical problem: rotate and zoom the cube, study every face, then tap arrows in the right order to send them along rails, remove obstacles, and trigger cascading clears. The controls are simple — the depth comes from spatial relationships and sequencing across faces.

You’ll work with a single core mechanic (arrow release) that scales into many behaviors: short-range pushes, long slides across a face, blockers that change paths, and interactions that let one arrow clear several others when timed correctly. Learning how arrows interact — when to trigger, when to wait, and which face to inspect next — is the key to solving larger layouts. Well-executed moves produce satisfying chain reactions and visual payoff.

The game features hundreds of handcrafted puzzles arranged to teach, test, and reward. Early puzzles introduce basic movement and interaction in compact layouts so players can learn the building blocks. As you progress, puzzles expand in size and complexity: multi-stage solutions, cross-face planning, and puzzles that require anticipating how a move on one face will ripple to another. Replay and experimentation are encouraged — many puzzles hide more efficient clears and combos that reveal themselves to observant players.

Visually, Arrow 3D: Space Puzzle places the cube in a tranquil space environment with neon arrow trails and clear, readable boards. Subtle animation and snappy feedback keep focus on planning rather than visual noise. The pacing is deliberately gentle: it supports short, rewarding sessions and longer stretches of concentrated problem solving. Whether you play for a quick burst between tasks or sink into a longer puzzle session, each level offers a tidy, mechanical satisfaction and a steady learning curve that grows with you.

Play to sharpen spatial reasoning, sequencing, and pattern recognition. The game is ideal for players who enjoy logical puzzles, mechanical systems, and “aha” moments born from planning and anticipation. Rotate the cube, release the right arrow, and watch the solution unfold.

apps.title: Aniimo
apps.summary:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in thrilling competitive battles. Choose your Aniimo and embark on an epic journey - one full of exploration, discovery, and adventure!

Seize every chance to capture and collect Aniimo to your heart's desire!

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

Twine with Aniimo to feel the world like they do

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

Jump into the adventure and enjoy exploring an expansive open world

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

Join exciting real-time challenges with Aniimo

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Enjoying camping and roadtrips with your friends

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

apps.title: Crowd Theory
apps.summary:
How well do you know the crowd?

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. Lock your guess, no takebacks, and watch the reveal - the crowd's true number, live, and your score is how far away you are. 2% away? You can read the room. 45% off? Maybe you've been living under a rock.

THE DAILY RITUAL

• One new question every day at 4pm ET - everyone plays the same 24-hour window
• Questions you can't help guessing: What percent of people think they're better-than-average drivers? What percent refrigerate ketchup? What percent fart in front of their spouse? What percent say please and thank you to AI?
• Live crowd numbers that move as votes come in

SEE WHO SAID WHAT

• Demographic breakdowns: how men, women, and every generation answered
• Daily takeaways on where the crowd split
• Every question ends in a conversation with the whole crowd

START A LEAGUE

• Your own private leaderboard with your group chat, your family, your office
• One link invites them - friends who have the app land straight in your league
• Finally settle who actually knows how people think

CLIMB THE BOARDS

• Today, 7-day, 30-day, and all-time leaderboards with your real rank
• Streaks, badges, and your Crowd DNA - discover how much you're actually like everyone else in Your Story

PLAY THE BACK CATALOG

Missed a day? Every past question is still playable. The crowd is locked - your read isn't.

Anonymous by design - no email to play, no ads, no trackers. We will never sell your personal information or let anyone target you based on what you answered.

apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

👉 Download the game for free. Your favourite word association is waiting.

📧 We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at support@quriousbit.com
